full_page.content:
1930, April
FATHER SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 42 Cont.
April 3rd promising perpetual enrollment, if operation were not necessary - sobs and tears last night of sorrow; This a.m. tears of joy.
Nov. 26 Edw'd T. Shappee 39 was operated on -- "Very Malignant" blood can- cer "tercoma" in Providence Hospital . . . no hope of recovery . . Jan 20th "30. was given ten days to live came and was enrolled . went home and had good meal and slept . is here today with wife and 3 children - all in perfect health . Deo Gr.
Stella Mc Grath 25 - "dying" of tuberculosis for five years . comes Today with mother and sister in quite perfect health - weight before sick 110 now 170 Deo Gr.
1931
1931, August
Aug. 7th E'd Quinlan 68, of Saginaw Enrolled last Wednesday as against threatened cancer under lip. This is Friday and Mr. & Mrs. E'd came to express appreciation for what seem a Cure
13th H. Mounette 41 of Toledo came To-day a blind man from Toledo - enrolled perpetually promising more frequent Communion
Page 43 Sep. 14 "Three years Ago this Fall, Thomas Lucas 66 hopelessly confined to bed with Arthritis was enrolled in S.M.A/ Daughter promised a per- petual enrollment as soon as an improvement were reported (from Durand, Wis). Next time she heard from Mother the pain had entirely gone and he was around in a wheel-chair. The pain till then fear- ful, .... now sometimes gets along with crutch & cane - not the least pain left
To-day 3-yr-old Babbara Hertsberg Jewish Child was enrolled by her parents. The only child of this couple has never spoken: her eyes are very defective: has been to Good St. Ann of Mont Real and St. Joseph's Shrine
Mrs. Jane Glunz (48) has 4 children of 5233 Oregon Ave. dying with pernitious Enemia. Doctor wants $50. Twin sister and her own son are taking blood test To-day, but as yet no one has the $50. We en- roll her To-day 11.45 a.m. instead of going out with relic to visit her. --- Twin sister and other sister Anna Doran promises more frequent Com'ion.
